description: A brand's angles: the pitch each ad leans on, for whom; offers sit on top. Each angle has a type (problem/solution, proof, founder story…), a name, the newest hook, the persona it speaks to (nickname, the buyer's situation in their words, age range when shown, awareness stage), the product, how many ads, live ads and landing pages use it, first and last seen, and the offers those ads carried. Most used first, up to `limit`, with `totalCount`. Use it for 'how does this brand sell' or to compare two brands' messaging. Fields this workspace can't see are null and named in the item's `locked` list (`estimates` = sales, visits, traffic). A capped list sets `planLimit` (`maxResults`, `hiddenResults`) and has no next page. Never estimate omitted values. Returns data only, shown to no one. Once you know the answer, call sightglass_show once with this resultId to show it as cards; it doesn't search again. For multi-step competitor research, call skills with name "replo".

companyRef.description: Company id or slug. Users call companies 'brands'.

limit.description: Most results to return: 20 by default, up to 50. Ones carried by ads come first.

projectId.description: Replo project id, from list_projects. Its workspace decides which Sightglass fields and history come back. Only tools that say they save something (an asset or a Canvas file) write to this project.

workspaceId.description: Replo workspace id, from list_workspaces. Decides which workspace's Sightglass fields and history come back; required when the user has more than one workspace.

name: sightglass_find_angles
title: Find a brand's angles
